title: Colin the Caterpillar cake company to expand with HSBC UK funding - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: An Oldham-based bakery has secured an eight-figure funding package from HSBC UK to support market expansion plans.

headings.text: Colin the Caterpillar cake company to expand with HSBC UK funding

body: Share link to this page on X
Share link to this page on Facebook

Park Cakes, which operates two cake and hot dessert manufacturing sites in Greater Manchester, is best known for its production of the M&S Colin the Caterpillar range, but produces a wide range of baked goods for UK and international retailers.
The business is now using HSBC UK funding to enhance its manufacturing capabilities.

Paul Morton, Chief Financial Officer for Park Cakes, said: “When we started looking for financial support for our ambitious plans, we knew we needed an organisation that could grasp the scale of the opportunities that lay ahead. In HSBC UK, we have found a banking partner that understands our business and how we are looking to grow further. We look forward to what the future brings in this collaboration.”

Dean Smith, Global Relationship Director, HSBC UK, added: “Park Cakes has been able to combine the right structures and processes to deliver impressive year-on-year growth. This is a business with best practice at its core, evidenced by its rise to the top of the industry. Following this expansion, we’re excited to see how Park Cakes utilises funding to continue growing across the sector.”

Park Cakes has been in operation for over 80 years, with 2,000 employees currently supplying over 130 million cakes to customers every year. This HSBC UK deal was supported by Allan Wilkinson, HSBC UK Head of Agri-Foods.

HSBC UK HSBC UK serves over 15 million active customers across the UK, supported by 23,800 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.

HSBC Holdings plc HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 56 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,233bn at 31 December 2025, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
